kind: Event-prior retrospective context-rule comparison; historical outcomes were already known

rules.repeat: Prior Assembly seat-winning party; prior IND abstains
rules.statewide: Prior statewide Assembly seat-count leader everywhere; ties and IND leader abstain
rules.parliament: Prior ordinary Parliamentary segment leading-party code; IND, ties, missing/withheld or unresolved coding abstain

comparison: All three primary scores use the intersection of eligible seats. Full eligible denominators are separate. Existing Assembly-only reports are unchanged.
limitations: Only two historical transitions; seats are correlated, not independent repeated elections.
Historical outcomes were inspected before this protocol; no unseen or prospective validation is claimed.
Sources were acquired in 2026; original historical publication-version availability remains unverified.
2014 uses combined-sheet rows with five selected scan comparisons, not sixty complete station audits.
2019 Henglep remains withheld; its combined-sheet row is not substituted.
Parliamentary local leads are contextual inputs, never Assembly target outcomes.
No fitted model, causal findings, sensitive-identity inputs, 2027 favourites or probabilities are produced.
